kpis.label: Net income (TTM)
kpis.note: GAAP; includes a one-time, non-cash $7.8B loss on converting notes to stock

notes: Q4 FY26 components revenue $649.4M (+103% YoY) and systems revenue $356.9M (+123% YoY); the Q1 FY27 guide midpoint ($1.25B) is more than 130% above a year earlier.

runContext.title: The 2025 run
runContext.summary: LITE closed at $49.56 on Apr 4, 2025, its 2025 low, during the tariff selloff. It ended 2025 at $368.59 (+644% from the low) and closed at $1,111.07 on Oct 7, 2026, about 22x the low.
signals: Revenue growth bottomed at −16.9% YoY (Jun 2024 quarter), then +6.1%, +9.7%, +16.0% and +55.9% (Jun 2025 quarter).
Gross margin rose four quarters in a row, from 23.8% to 37.3%.
NVIDIA picked Lumentum as a silicon-photonics laser partner for its co-packaged-optics switches in March 2025.
At the low it traded near 2.3x sales and ~17x forward earnings, after a market-wide (tariff) drop rather than a company problem.
runContext.caveat: Hindsight: the size of the move wasn't knowable in 2025. Today LITE fails the 'not already run' and 'still cheap' parts of the same checklist.

news.title: Lumentum slides with the optical group as the tech selloff deepens
news.summary: Credo, Marvell, Coherent, Applied Optoelectronics and AXT also fell sharply. Lumentum is more than 25% below its $1,143 52-week peak; insider selling totals about $175.8M over the past year with no purchases. The stock closed down about 11.5% at $752.54 ahead of its Nov. 5 report.

news.title: Lumentum among last week's biggest AI-linked losers, up about 3.8% premarket
news.summary: Lumentum, CoreWeave and Nebius each lost more than a quarter of their value last week as SOXX fell 11.8%. Per Koyfin, LITE's RSI was 37.4 and it trades at 37.8 times forward earnings; it led Monday's premarket rebound in the group with a gain of about 3.8%.

news.title: Lumentum falls another 5.2% to $824.13 as optical stocks keep sliding
news.summary: LITE dropped 5.2% and Coherent about 7% on Friday as the AI-hardware selloff pushed the Nasdaq to its worst week since June (down 4.5%).

news.title: Optical stocks extend their slide as money rotates into defensives; Lumentum slips again
news.summary: Coherent fell about 7%, Applied Optoelectronics about 6% and the Roundhill photonics ETF about 5% as fund managers trimmed AI hardware; none of the three issued news in the past week. LITE closed down 3.0% at $869.54, still up well over 100% year to date.

news.title: Optical stocks slide again on AI funding fears; Lumentum closes down 9.3%
news.summary: A sector-wide repricing of AI optical suppliers continued after Broadcom's and Intel's CEOs warned capital access and borrowing costs could constrain AI build-outs: Coherent fell about 7%, Applied Optoelectronics about 9%, and the Roundhill photonics ETF about 8%. LITE closed at $896.33 (from $987.99) with no company-specific news.

news.title: Lumentum sinks 9.8% after Broadcom's CEO compares AI investing to a casino
news.summary: No company-specific news: the drop followed Hock Tan's weekend remarks that many investors "set very extreme expectations" and that enterprise AI token use is still largely experimental. LITE fell $107.95 to $995.41, a week after hitting a record $1,143 on its CEO's "almost sold out" for 2029 comment.

news.title: LITE, COHR, AAOI surge as Lumentum CEO says AI parts sold out through early 2029
news.summary: Lumentum said its optical components are "completely sold out" through early 2029 on AI data-center demand, lifting optical names; LITE closed +5.22% at $1,103.36 after trading as high as $1,143.

news.title: Optics stocks rally on sold-out capacity: AAOI and Lumentum up 7%, Coherent 5%
news.summary: The sold-out signal reversed weeks of profit-taking in optical names; the Roundhill Photonics & Optics ETF (LYTE) rose ~3% vs SPY +0.4% in the morning.

news.title: Lumentum stock lights up AI-fueled buy zone
news.summary: IBD lists LITE on its IBD 50, Big Cap 20, Sector Leaders and Breakout Stocks lists and says top funds are adding shares.

news.title: Lumentum shares fall 7% on AI-slowdown talk
news.summary: Shares fell as much as 7% in the morning on calls to slow AI buildouts and higher oil prices; LITE closed down 2.0% at $1,111.07.

news.title: This photonics stock is already up 600% in one year. Now it's breaking out again
news.summary: A technical analyst sees a breakout from a base dating back to April, with $1,200 as a near-term target and the old $1,000 ceiling as support.

news.title: Stifel raises Lumentum target to $1,232 from $1,100, keeps Buy
news.summary: In its September-quarter preview, Stifel said it still sees AI infrastructure deployment as supply-gated, not demand-gated.

listContext.trend: Consensus target implies about 57% upside; analysts forecast revenue +110% this fiscal year and +57% next (S&P Global consensus).
listContext.method: Conservative growth at a reasonable price (GARP), rerun on the full US-listed market (StockAnalysis / S&P Global screener, Oct 22, 2026 close). A stock qualifies if it has: market cap of $10B or more and at least a year of trading history; TTM revenue growth of 15% or more that analysts expect to continue (consensus revenue growth of 8%+ next fiscal year and 8%+ a year over the next 3 years); a positive forward P/E of 35 or less and a PEG of 1.5 or less where available; a Buy or Strong Buy consensus from 5+ analysts with 15%+ upside to the average target; beta of 2.6 or less; share count up no
